descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S14 Search finds a patient beyond the first page of 50, both contexts

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Hospital: search by name, by room, by MRN and by diagnosis each returns the correct matching patients, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 2; TFA-92581 AC 5)
  • U4 Nursing Home: search by name, by unit/room, by MRN and by facility each returns the correct matching residents, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 3; TFA-92581 AC 6)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given 51 Hospital patients in rooms 1–51 plus one in room 999; 51 residents in Rm 1–51 plus one in Rm 999, all on today's list

When Search 'Zuniga' on the Hospital list; search 'Zeller' on Today's Visits and on All Residents

Then The searched patient (52nd in room order, outside the first page) is listed and no message says nothing matches

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): cp1 mustContain 'QA Hosp Zuniga', mustNotContain 'No patients match'; cp2 and cp3 mustContain 'QA Resident Zeller', mustNotContain 'No residents match' (U1, U4). Server-side sparse paging is also covered by S05 (Hospital) and S06 (Nursing Home)

Where it ran: dev unit U72; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)
